intake.name: Hypnopet
intake.loreSummary: Hypnopets resemble glowing, golden-furred bunny rabbits with a single color-changing unicorn horn atop their heads. They were created by the Telypso Generator as service animals and therapists for the insane Vallerii imprisoned on the world, where their natural empathic healing abilities served to balance and treat patients. When their horn begins to pulse and swirl with psychedelic color, it hypnotizes others and locks them in a trance, which was useful for sedating patients when they entered into dangerous bouts of mania. With the Nemesis Plague reducing the patient population of Telypso, many Hypnopets have taken to the stars as healers, though some have been forced into service by King Kozrak, who uses their hypnotic abilities as crowd control on rebellious worlds.
appearance: Single color-changing unicorn horn atop the head

mustHave.feature: A single unicorn horn atop the head (it changes color; the color change and pulse are animation, recorded for later)

carryOver.feature: Ears hang down past the cheeks, wide and soft, almost to the ground
A large round head relative to the body
Big hind feet with visible toe and heel pads
A paler face mask and chest than the rest of the coat
The horn rises from a tuft of fur on the crown and has a spiral twist

openForDesign.feature: Exact golden color range and how the glow reads
Any coat pattern beyond the pale face and chest
Horn spiral style and its resting color
Pose for modeling: a neutral stance on four legs (your seated pose stays the look reference)
